description: Returns a weekly Torah portion: its name, Hebrew name, meaning and Shabbat date, with its Torah, Haftarah and Besorah (New Covenant) readings and links, on the Diaspora calendar. Give a name ('Toledot'), a date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the portion read on the Shabbat on or after it, or list=true for every portion; with none, this week's. Use when the user asks about a weekly Torah portion, its Haftarah or its New Covenant (New Testament) reading.

date.description: a date as YYYY-MM-DD; gives the portion read on the Shabbat on or after it

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

name: get_parashah
title: Weekly Torah portion
